info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Rideshare Rides Fares-v2-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Fares Retrieval API allows users to access current fare information for rideshare services efficiently. By querying the endpoint, developers can retrieve a list of fares associated with various rideshare rides, enabling applications to inform customers about pricing and to compare options. This API serves rideshare applications, payment platforms, and any service that aggregates transportation options. Use cases include fare comparisons, cost estimations for users, and integration into ride-booking systems.

get.summary: Retrieve the fare estimate for a ride.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to get an estimated fare for a specific ride based on the provided parameters. Use this service to inform customers of the expected costs before they book a ride.

requestBody.description: This request retrieves the fare estimate for a ride based on the provided parameters. Ensure all required fields are filled for an accurate fare calculation.
